## [1.11.0](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/compare/v1.10.0...v1.11.0) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* clarify per-patch compatibility ([9cc5c22](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/9cc5c222c18afe2e71f2c22d5c8a6eb36f669642))
* distinguish file types in supported version headings ([af47245](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/af4724599e3e472ecb984a580531ab1407ccd264))
* **zalo:** apply AMOLED overlay to dark theme resources ([797d2ab](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/797d2ab135a1fcf89d5a90e966b0200d7755280f))
* **zalo:** apply AMOLED to native header surfaces ([0e7dead](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/0e7dead7399921782bd11db9e643980a8137a0ea))
* **zalo:** avoid unnecessary stranger notification restart prompt ([9b5b88b](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/9b5b88b5731b26506cf9087894ff869350f82adc))
* **zalo:** cover more AMOLED theme surfaces ([12c12a5](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/12c12a5972a2fe4e717aa575612ba1835f562296))
* **zalo:** match native theme setting icon ([488e453](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/488e4539178d81ca3aeceb88a0b7f306186e3271))
* **zalo:** resolve the version-specific Drive account refresh method ([d23cd9b](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/d23cd9bae5252b732da7528051a5b69c110dde9f))
* **zalo:** retry unavailable recall preference reads ([6f87502](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/6f87502c2ceda9b0bc15d245d49e47042e6bc758))
* **zalo:** validate launcher PNGs and navigation bounds ([1c158ee](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/1c158eebd1ba5549d1ff1efeef896d280556151c))
* **zalo:** validate package rename counts per version ([abe1706](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/abe17064712d31c86f63c6d56822e25f8c95e167)), closes [#51](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/51)

### ✨ New Features

* **threads:** hide suggested account carousel ([0661c2a](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/0661c2a63cb33a806e37d8e967c7722dfaa16677))
* **zalo:** add backup and notification settings ([61b1889](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/61b18891b91631c9c44ac2479d54ff2087f4fccd))
* **zalo:** add in-app appearance controls ([f80fa48](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/f80fa487bcd0cd297c0844edb7e58aaad010e80f)), closes [#55](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/55) [#56](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/56)
* **zalo:** add native navigation tab settings ([871f868](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/871f8686eebe1acfd125ac37fd8c7011ea1f97d0))
* **zalo:** add recall retention and customization controls ([b53e7af](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/b53e7afee6e32454e1cd0cc5c3ccc7a016bfa9d9)), closes [#53](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/53) [#54](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/54) [#55](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/55) [#56](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/56) [#59](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/59) [#60](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/60) [#61](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/issues/61)
* **zalo:** make AMOLED dark theme optional and cover the Me tab ([16f3ada](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/16f3adae19b7c52324d076a60db8b9a89d6fc171))

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the launcher.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Allows a renamed clone alongside Threads. Login, content providers or push may break.

options.description: The new application package name (e.g. com.instagram.barcelona.morphe).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from the Threads feed. Other surfaces are unaffected.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Removes suggested-account units from the Threads feed. Other suggestion surfaces are unchanged.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens web links externally when possible; otherwise Threads handles them normally.

patches.name: Remove AD_ID permission
patches.description: Removes advertising ID permissions. Meta's own analytics are unaffected.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Forces pure black surfaces across Zalo's dark theme, including the Me tab root. Light mode is untouched.

patches.name: Bypass Zalo Drive Contacts permission gate
patches.description: Allows Drive photo restore account selection without Contacts permission.

patches.name: Bypass native startup tamper check
patches.description: Allows the re-signed app to start on the supported arm64 Zalo build.

patches.name: Change Zalo app icon
patches.description: Adds a user-supplied PNG icon and an in-app switch between the original and custom launcher icons.

options.description: Path accessible to the patcher. Use a square, non-interlaced 48–2048 px PNG, with padding for adaptive masking.

patches.name: Change Zalo app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the launcher.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change Zalo package name
patches.description: Allows a renamed clone alongside Zalo. Login, push, sharing and deep links may be affected.

options.description: The new application package name (for example com.zing.zalo.morphe).

patches.name: Configurable native backup interval
patches.description: Sets Zalo 26.08.01's automatic backup interval to 1, 3, 6 or 12 hours. Existing backup requirements still apply. For 26.10.02 use the in-app interval settings.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks selected offline and Google-served ads. Story and community sponsored placements require a separate patch.

patches.name: Disable sponsored placements
patches.description: Disables Story and community sponsored placements. Server-delivered and Official Account promotions may remain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and crash reporting
patches.description: Stops selected Zalo analytics and crash reporting. Messaging is unaffected.

patches.name: Enable Google Drive photo backup
patches.description: Makes Zalo's Google Drive photo backup available to more accounts. Google authorization and Drive retention still apply.

patches.name: Enable avatar saving
patches.description: Restores Save photo for avatars opened from a profile and allows screenshots. Other screenshot protections are unchanged.

patches.name: Enable profile cover saving
patches.description: Restores Save photo for profile cover photos and allows screenshots. Other viewers are unchanged.

patches.name: Enable stranger notifications
patches.description: Adds an in-app switch to allow Stranger Box notifications, enabled by default. Off uses Zalo's native gate; other settings and delivery restrictions still apply.

patches.name: Filter promo notifications
patches.description: Filters Timeline, Stories and Zalo Video notifications. Message, call, friend-request and birthday notifications are unaffected.

patches.name: Hide Business Box
patches.description: Hides Business Box from the chat list without hiding ordinary or user-initiated Official Account chats.

patches.name: Hide Media Box
patches.description: Hides Media Box from the chat list without deleting its content.

patches.name: Hide Newsfeed promotions
patches.description: Hides native Zinstant ad rows and suggested Zalo Video sections in Newsfeed automatically. Ordinary video posts remain visible.

patches.name: Hide chat list ads
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the chat list. Server-delivered promotions and other ads may remain.

patches.name: Hide navigation tabs
patches.description: Adds settings to hide Discovery, Contacts and Timeline individually. Tabs stay visible until hidden in Zeldris Patches; restart to apply.

patches.name: Keep expired media accessible
patches.description: Keeps locally stored large chat media accessible after expiry. Missing files and server restrictions are unaffected.

patches.name: Keep recalled messages
patches.description: Adds an initially off recall-retention switch in Zeldris Patches. Preserves locally received content with a recalled label; cannot recover missing content. Restart to apply.

patches.name: Native backup interval settings
patches.description: Adds a backup interval choice in Zeldris Patches. Native is the default; existing backup requirements apply.

patches.name: Prefer original photo quality
patches.description: Enables original photo quality by default. Upload limits and video are unaffected.

patches.name: Remove AD_ID permission
patches.description: Removes Zalo's advertising ID permissions. Messaging is unaffected.

patches.name: Remove media backup age limit
patches.description: Includes media of any age in Drive backup and restore. Drive retention and excluded media still apply.

patches.name: Suppress outbound seen status
patches.description: Stops sending read receipts while preserving delivery acknowledgements.

patches.name: Suppress outbound typing status
patches.description: Stops sending typing indicators. Incoming typing status is unaffected.

patches.name: microG Drive support
patches.description: Uses microG-RE for Google Drive account selection and sign-in. Requires app.revanced.android.gms and the app.revanced account type.
